recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "An auctioneer who started hearing the house", "body": "Carla Adams opens by telling Chance Garton how a former real estate broker and auctioneer became a clairvoyant practitioner. She moved into a turn of the century house, discovered after the fact that it sits on a ley line vortex, and her life reorganized around what spirit showed her. Instead of showing houses she now reads energy fields, and instead of helping people flip property she helps them flip old money mindset patterns. She also describes launching the Health Energy Podcast with two co-hosts, a Reiki and hypnotherapy practitioner and an RN focused on women's gut health."}, {"title": "Mapping the ancestral river and the ancestral field", "body": "Carla lays out the geography she works in, crediting Eileen McCusick for naming the ancestral rivers, the two streams of DNA information running about ten inches off each side of the body, mother on the left and father on the right. Beyond the individual biofield of five or six feet, she says, an ancestral field extends out to roughly thirty five feet, holding the life records of direct ancestors from conception at the outer edge to death, with a gap of a foot and a half or two between death energy and the personal field."}, {"title": "Why imagination is the thing on trial", "body": "Gabe reads a passage from Owen Barfield's Saving the Appearances praising William Blake's claim that imagination is the cardinal virtue and literalism the besetting sin of the age. Chance Garton runs with it, arguing there is no clean split between real thought and imaginary thought because all thinking is imagining. He ties free will to imagination and says what keeps people stuck is usually undiagnosed poverty of imagination, an inability to picture themselves larger than their circumstances. Carla adds that words like myth and imagination have been flattened into synonyms for lying."}, {"title": "A grandmother in wartime London and a racing heart", "body": "Chance Garton walks through a client case of sudden tachycardia. Working her ancestral river he inferred a grandmother left alone with children in danger, and the client confirmed the woman lived through the London bombings while her husband was at war. As a New Zealander the client had also endured severe lockdowns, and Chance describes those two similar traumas conjuncting in the field like an astrological aspect. Carla agrees the material compounds across generations, recalling how clearing her grandfather's sadness and then her grandmother's cleared her own. A second session traced grief for a mother-in-law who had died suddenly."}, {"title": "Hierarchy, the oneness and the placenta", "body": "Carla describes ancestors lingering in what she calls the biofield of nature, low voltage and grayscale, waiting for a descendant to help them transition into the oneness through a positive ley line vortex. She names a hierarchical group trained by bloodline ritual to intercept the newly dead, and Chance Garton says he has met the same thing around hospitals and calls it a spiritual war fought only by consent. They close on her newest find, the placenta's energy sitting off the right side of the third eye, which she treats as the guardian angel rejoining the person."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Carla Adams is a Biofield Tuning innovator and author of Ancestral River: A Spiritual Journey for the Living and the Dead. How do our biological predecessors show up in as information in our aura? What are the best ways to interact with them, for their benefit and ours? All our ancestors and all our future generations are present in us.
